newsHighlights.title: Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4 as it nears western Mexico
newsHighlights.summary: Hurricane Simon has intensified into a Category 4 storm as it approaches the western coast of Mexico, prompting evacuations and warnings of life-threatening storm surge.
newsHighlights.translation: 飓风“西蒙”在逼近墨西哥西部沿海时已增强为四级飓风，当地启动人员疏散，并发布可能危及生命的风暴潮预警。

newsHighlights.title: Road map set for ramping up green, new quality productive forces
newsHighlights.summary: China has laid out a top-level road map dedicated to accelerating the development of new quality productive forces, which analysts say could sustain long-term, greener economic expansion.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国发布了加速发展新质生产力的顶层路线图，分析人士认为这有助于支撑更绿色、更可持续的长期经济增长。

newsHighlights.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine reached 'energy ceasefire'
newsHighlights.summary: The United States announced that Russia and Ukraine have agreed on an 'energy ceasefire' aimed at halting strikes on power plants, refineries and other energy infrastructure.
newsHighlights.translation: 美方宣布俄罗斯与乌克兰已达成“能源停火”，旨在停止对电厂、炼油厂及其他能源基础设施的袭击。

newsHighlights.title: Submersible prepares to dive in western Pacific Ocean
newsHighlights.summary: A Chinese deep-sea submersible is preparing for a new dive in the western Pacific Ocean to collect samples and data on deep-sea biodiversity and ocean health.
newsHighlights.translation: 一台中国深海潜水器正准备在西太平洋下潜，以采集深海生物多样性与海洋健康状况的样本和数据。

quote.quote: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors; we borrow it from our children.
quote.author: Native American proverb (often attributed to Chief Seattle)
quote.translation: 我们并非从祖先那里继承了地球，而是从子孙那里借来了它。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们，环境资源并非私有财产，当代人只是暂时的使用者。它呼吁可持续发展：我们今天的能源政策、碳排放和海洋保护举措，都会直接决定后代能否拥有健康的地球。

vocabulary.example: Hurricane Simon continued to intensify as it moved over warm ocean waters.
vocabulary.translation: 飓风“西蒙”在温暖的洋面上移动时持续增强。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道：Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4 as it nears western Mexico，指风暴强度升级。

vocabulary.definition: 类别；等级（飓风按强度分级）
vocabulary.example: The storm was upgraded to a category 4 hurricane with winds exceeding 200 kilometers per hour.
vocabulary.translation: 该风暴被升级为四级飓风，风速超过每小时200公里。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN 报道：Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4，指萨菲尔-辛普森飓风等级。

vocabulary.definition: 风暴潮（台风或飓风引起的海水异常升高）
vocabulary.example: Authorities warned residents of a life-threatening storm surge along the coast.
vocabulary.translation: 当局警告沿海居民警惕危及生命的风暴潮。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自飓风“西蒙”逼近墨西哥沿海的灾情预警报道。

vocabulary.definition: 可持续的；能长期维持的
vocabulary.example: Officials said the new road map could better sustain long-term economic expansion in a sustainable way.
vocabulary.translation: 官员表示，新路线图能以更可持续的方式支撑长期经济增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily：Road map set for ramping up development，谈新质生产力与长期可持续增长。

vocabulary.example: The plan is dedicated to accelerating the development of new quality productive forces.
vocabulary.translation: 该规划致力于加速发展新质生产力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily：Road map set for ramping up development 的核心表述。

vocabulary.example: The energy ceasefire aims to protect power plants, refineries and other energy infrastructure.
vocabulary.translation: 该能源停火旨在保护电厂、炼油厂及其他能源基础设施。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 CGTN：Trump says Russia and Ukraine reached 'energy ceasefire'。

vocabulary.definition: 排放；散发（尤指气体、污染物）
vocabulary.example: Strikes on refineries can cause massive emissions of toxic gases and greenhouse gases.
vocabulary.translation: 对炼油厂的袭击可能导致有毒气体和温室气体的大量排放。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联能源设施被袭新闻：燃油燃烧与设施损毁带来的碳与污染物排放问题。

vocabulary.example: The submersible will collect samples to study deep-sea biodiversity in the western Pacific.
vocabulary.translation: 该潜水器将采集样本，研究西太平洋的深海生物多样性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 ChinaDaily：Submersible prepares to dive in western Pacific Ocean。

vocabulary.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
vocabulary.example: Coastal cities need more resilient infrastructure to survive stronger hurricanes.
vocabulary.translation: 沿海城市需要更有韧性的基础设施，以抵御更强的飓风。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联飓风“西蒙”报道：气候灾害频发背景下提升城市与社区气候韧性。

vocabulary.definition: 减轻；缓解（尤指减少灾害或气候变化影响）
vocabulary.example: Climate mitigation and adaptation should go hand in hand as extreme weather grows more common.
vocabulary.translation: 随着极端天气日益频繁，气候减缓与适应应齐头并进。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联飓风强度上升的报道，指向温室气体减排与灾害风险降低。

pattern.pattern: be dedicated to + doing sth.（致力于做某事）
pattern.example: China has laid out a top-level road map dedicated to accelerating the development of new quality productive forces.
pattern.translation: 中国制定了一份顶层路线图，致力于加速发展新质生产力。
pattern.usage: dedicated to 后接动名词，表示“专注于/致力于……的”，可用于描述政策、机构、技术的目标。注意此处 to 是介词，不可接动词原形。类似表达还有 be committed to doing、be devoted to doing。

grammar.title: 新闻标题中的一般现在时（Headline Present Tense）
grammar.explanation: 英语新闻标题常使用一般现在时表示刚刚发生或正在发生的事件，以增强时效感和冲击力，即使正文使用过去时。阅读新闻时不要误以为事件尚未发生。此外，标题常省略冠词和系动词。
examples: Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4 as it nears western Mexico.
Trump says Russia and Ukraine reached 'energy ceasefire'.

pronunciation.tips: 重音落在第二个音节 /steɪ/ 上，首音节弱读为 /sə/（中央元音 schwa）。词尾 -able 读作 /əbl/，不要读成“ei-bou”。整体节奏是：轻—重—轻—轻。可先慢读 sə-STEI-nə-bəl，再加速连读。
examples: Sustainable development means meeting today's needs without harming future generations.
The country is seeking sustainable and greener ways to power its economy.

reading.title: Stronger Storms, Greener Roads: Why Sustainability Matters Now
reading.content:
As Hurricane Simon strengthened into a Category 4 storm and approached the coast of western Mexico, thousands of residents were urged to evacuate. Scientists say warmer ocean waters give hurricanes more energy, making storms stronger and rainfall heavier than in the past. This is one reason climate mitigation has become urgent worldwide.

At the same time, governments are looking for cleaner ways to grow. China has laid out a top-level road map dedicated to accelerating the development of new quality productive forces, which analysts believe could support greener, more sustainable economic expansion. In another development, an announced "energy ceasefire" between Russia and Ukraine aims to protect power plants and refineries, since damaged energy infrastructure causes both pollution and fuel shortages.

Deep beneath the sea, a Chinese submersible is preparing to dive in the western Pacific to study ocean biodiversity. Protecting the ocean, cutting emissions and building resilient cities are all parts of the same goal: handing a healthy planet to the next generation.
reading.translation:
随着飓风“西蒙”增强为四级飓风并逼近墨西哥西部沿海，数千名居民被紧急疏散。科学家表示，海水温度升高为飓风提供了更多能量，使风暴比过去更强、降雨更猛烈。这也是全球气候减缓工作日益紧迫的原因之一。

与此同时，各国政府正在寻求更清洁的发展方式。中国制定了顶层路线图，致力于加速发展新质生产力，分析人士认为这将支撑更绿色、更可持续的经济增长。另一项进展是，俄乌宣布的“能源停火”旨在保护电厂和炼油厂，因为受损的能源基础设施既会造成污染，也会导致燃料短缺。

在深海之中，一台中国潜水器正准备下潜西太平洋，研究海洋生物多样性。保护海洋、减少排放、建设韧性城市，都是同一个目标的组成部分：把一个健康的星球交给下一代。
reading.sourceNote: 本文改写自 CGTN《Hurricane Simon strengthens to category 4 as it nears western Mexico》、CGTN《Trump says Russia and Ukraine reached 'energy ceasefire'》、ChinaDaily《Road map set for ramping up development》及 ChinaDaily《Submersible prepares to dive in western Pacific Ocean》等今日新闻素材。
